## Purpose

This SOP provides standardized checklists for packing, verifying, and
returning field equipment. Using a checklist before every field outing
prevents forgotten items, reduces time lost in the field, and ensures
that equipment is returned clean, functional, and ready for the next
user. This SOP complements the safety and planning procedures in
[SOP-F001 Field Safety](SOP-F001-field-safety.qmd) and the equipment
inventory in
[SOP-L007 Equipment Inventory](../lab_sops/SOP-L007-equipment-inventory.qmd).


## Scope

- **Applies to:** All EA Program field outings, including research
  sampling events, class field trips, and equipment loans
- **Does not apply to:** Laboratory-only procedures; drone operations
  (see dedicated SOP when available)
- **Location:** Equipment stored in SGM 131, 132, 133, and 134;
  deployed to all EA field sites


## Responsibilities

| Role              | Responsibility                                         |
|:------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------|
| Field Lead        | Verify checklist completion before departure; confirm equipment return |
| Trained Personnel | Pack and check equipment; clean and return after use   |
| New Students      | Assist with packing under supervision; learn storage locations |


## Procedure

### Before Departure

1. Identify which **activity modules** (Section 5) apply to the
   planned field work. Most outings require the Core Module plus one
   or more activity-specific modules.
2. Print or copy the relevant checklists. Check off each item as it is
   packed.
3. For instruments requiring calibration (Eureka Manta2, pH meter),
   calibrate in the lab before packing. Record calibration results in
   the field notebook.
4. Verify that all batteries are charged (Crime-Lite, GPS, walkie-
   talkies) and that backup batteries are included.
5. Confirm cooler ice or ice packs are frozen and ready.
6. Complete the Field Work Planning Form in
   [SOP-F001](SOP-F001-field-safety.qmd), Section 13.
7. The field lead initials the checklist and confirms vehicle
   reservation per [SOP-F100](SOP-F100-vehicles.qmd) if applicable.

### On Site

1. Unpack systematically; keep items organized to avoid loss
2. At the end of the sampling event, re-check the checklist to confirm
   all items are accounted for before leaving the site
3. Note any damaged or malfunctioning equipment on the checklist

### After Return

1. Clean all equipment per the relevant method SOP (rinse sampling
   equipment with DI water, wipe down instruments, dry sieves)
2. Return every item to its designated storage location (see room
   assignments below and
   [SOP-L007](../lab_sops/SOP-L007-equipment-inventory.qmd))
3. Recharge batteries and replace consumables (sample bottles, filters,
   preservatives) for the next user
4. Report any damaged, lost, or malfunctioning items to the field lead
   or lab manager immediately
5. File the completed checklist with the field data sheets

### Storage Locations

| Storage Room | Equipment Category                                    |
|:-------------|:------------------------------------------------------|
| SGM 131      | Tapes, sieves, survey scopes, infiltrometers, walkie-talkies |
| SGM 132      | Vehicles, coolers, generators                         |
| SGM 133      | Sampling bottles, sondes, VanDorn bottles, LiCor sensor, microscope, analytical instruments |
| SGM 134      | DI water system, glassware, vacuum filtration supplies |

This checklist applies to every field trip regardless of activity type.

|:-----------------------------------------|:----------|:------|
| Completed Field Work Planning Form ([SOP-F001](SOP-F001-field-safety.qmd)) | --  | [ ] |

| Cell phone, charged, with emergency contacts | Personal | [ ] |
| First aid kit                            | In vehicle | [ ] |
| Sunscreen and sun hat                    | Personal  | [ ] |
| Full water bottles (one per person)      | Personal  | [ ] |
| Nitrile gloves (box)                     | SGM 133   | [ ] |
| GPS unit or smartphone with GPS app      | SGM 133   | [ ] |
| Camera (or phone camera)                 | Personal  | [ ] |

| Trash bag (leave no trace)               | --        | [ ] |

## Quality Control

- The field lead verifies the checklist before departure and confirms
  that all items are returned after the outing
- Any items found damaged or missing in the field are noted on the
  checklist and reported to the lab manager within 24 hours
- Completed checklists are filed with the field data sheets for the
  sampling event
- At the start of each semester, review all module checklists against
  the equipment inventory ([SOP-L007](../lab_sops/SOP-L007-equipment-inventory.qmd))
  and update storage locations or item lists as needed

## Training Record

Before leading a field outing, personnel must:

1. Read this SOP and [SOP-F001 Field Safety](SOP-F001-field-safety.qmd)
   in full
2. Know the storage locations for all items in the Core Module and at
   least one activity-specific module
3. Demonstrate proper packing, transport, and return procedures under
   supervision
4. Be signed off by the PI or field lead
